name: ferry
description: Leeway's ferry horn (engine/audio/voices.hpp, CityNoise, its ferry layer), at full loudness. An event every 35 .. 90 s; each draws its pitch, 115 .. 145 Hz, and its length, 1.8 .. 2.6 s: a sawtooth low-passed at 600 Hz with a 0.15 s attack and a release over the last 0.3 s, gain 1.4, then Leeway's ferry 0.4 and master 0.8 into tanh. No inputs: distance and stereo placement (Leeway's cityPlacement, cityReference and rolloff) are the adapter's job, not this recipe's. Deviations: the first event comes at 1 s, where Leeway's comes at 25 s, so a short render or a listener in the playground hears it; the release is exponential (time constant 0.15 s, starting 0.3 s before the end) where Leeway's is a linear 0.3 s ramp to zero at the end; the wait for the next event starts at the event's start, where Leeway's starts at its end, so events come 1.8 .. 2.6 s sooner; the saw restarts its phase at each event and keeps running between events, where Leeway's pauses; the pitch and length reach the saw and the envelope once per 128-sample control block.
